subject: general
question: The Fifth Schedule of the Indian Constitution contains provisions for the administration and control of which of the following?

options.text: Union and State Lists of the Seventh Schedule
Disqualification of legislators on grounds of defection

solution: The correct answer is __**Scheduled Areas and Scheduled Tribes**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **The Fifth Schedule of the Indian Constitution** specifically deals with the administration and control of **Scheduled Areas and Scheduled Tribes**. • It provides for the establishment of a **Tribes Advisory Council** in states having Scheduled Areas to ensure the welfare and advancement of Scheduled Tribes. • The schedule empowers the **Governor of a state** to make regulations for the peace and good governance of Scheduled Areas after consulting the Tribes Advisory Council. • **Scheduled Areas** are regions identified as socially and economically backward, inhabited predominantly by Scheduled Tribes, and require special attention for their development. • The President of India has the authority to declare areas as Scheduled Areas and modify their boundaries as necessary.
